All three root workflows are workflow_dispatch-only and time-bounded; none ran.

impact_map: Build parity affects delivered bytes and rollback.
Candidate lifecycle controls whether review can be bypassed.
Workflow controls affect metered use and publication.
Documentation parity affects install, upgrade, support, security, and rights understanding.
Rights, fresh-host, hosted-provider, independent review, and publication gates are distinct.

invariants.statement: Exactly one Nova plugin exposes 25 visible roots and 16 nested MIND cores.
Imports and persona match the lock; protected roots receive no edition overlay.
Repeated builds match and Codex/Claude skill bytes are identical.
Built host packages remain awaiting independent review and require it; they are not sealed.
All root workflows are manual-only and have explicit timeout ceilings.
Ordinary use requires no Python, Ollama, embeddings, vector DB, hook, daemon, or estate.
Optional state uses four selectors, never .codex, preserves but does not inject extras, and fails atomically.
Customer docs retain executable journeys and blocked redistribution state.
Hosted, paid, publication, and external actions require separate authority.

risks.statement: Absent component rights permit an unauthorized public distribution.
False ready metadata can hide the rights blocker.
Topology drift exposes the wrong product.
Custody drift or protected-root edits break provenance.
Nondeterminism or host drift delivers unreviewed bytes.
State fallback, retired-selector injection, or partial init violates custody/recovery.
Source/package documentation drift gives broken or unsafe journeys.
Static success may hide fresh-host binding failures.
Automatic or unbounded workflows can consume quota or publish without a bounded decision.
Local Windows evidence may be overclaimed as hosted cross-platform evidence.
A moving source tree invalidates observations.
Package evidence may be overclaimed as efficacy for every specialist.
Publication under build-only authority exposes an unlicensed candidate.
Premature sealing can masquerade as completed independent review.
